case_notes.content:
Met for Initial Case Management Session. 

Briefcase & Gates Update:
- Gate 1 (IDs): Participant has his Birth Certificate. Needs a physical Social Security Card (plans to order online). Knows his state ID number by heart.
- Gate 2 (Housing/DL): Stays in Lexington. Owes ~$300 in reinstatement fees + potential ticket fees. Plans to pay these off in ~2 weeks to get a beginner's permit. Will use computer lab time to study for the permit test.
- Gate 3 (Health/Bank): Needs dental work (wisdom teeth) and an eye exam (glasses). Mother is assisting with insurance. Discussed setting up a traditional bank account (FCU/local bank) rather than Chime to assist with credit building.
- Gate 4 (Career): Long-term goal is CDL. Discussed the WIOA program through SC Works which can cover up to $5,000 for CDL school. CM provided information on the sequential steps to achieve this.

CBT / Action Plan Alignment:
- Identified risky workplace situations: being over-talked, disrespected, and micromanaged (given 10 tasks 10 minutes before shift end).
- Identified triggers for associating with negative crowds: Boredom, internet exposure, and temptations for 'fast money'. 

Next Steps:
- Order SSN card online.
- Review ticket fees/reinstatement fees and plan for payment.
- Utilize computer lab for DMV permit practice tests.

Called to let him know he's near the top of the waitlist and to check in. He didn't end up looking for temp work, instead he had his surgery for his hernia. He said he's recovered and available to come in for orientation when his time comes. He also confirmed he has transportation.

- Owes $845 in reinstatement fees. Went to the DMV yesterday and has the sheet with the fees he owes.
- Needs a hernia removed, has seen a doctor and is waiting to schedule a surgery
- Was sure that his mom and step dad would be able to get him to and from the program daily. I pushed it a bit to let him know if he's not able to get there even one day, he'll most likely be moved back to reentry nav and bottom of the waitlist. He was adamant that it would be fine.
- On federal supervision

*not looking for much reentry nav support. Is going to some sort of temp agency job fair tomorrow where you're "hired on the spot". He wasn't sure who it was with/what it was called, but I let him know to keep me posted on how that goes and to reach out with any other needs. If he isn't hired tomorrow, I will search for some temp agencies for him to try while he waits for a spot to open up. 

*adding to waitlist. Going to follow up about his surgery dates (may need to adjust when we bring him in if his surgery would interfere with program involvement
